title: Email with Parameter Extraction
query: Send a quick message to john@company.com letting him know the meeting has been rescheduled to 3pm tomorrow

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a detailed email with subject and body

tools.name: send_quick_message
tools.description: Send a quick message without subject line

arguments.message: The meeting has been rescheduled to 3pm tomorrow

explanation: The user wants to send a 'quick message' which suggests send_quick_message is more appropriate than send_email (which requires a subject line). The key is recognizing: (1) 'quick message' suggests simpler function, (2) recipient is 'john@company.com', (3) message content should capture the essential information about the meeting being rescheduled to 3pm tomorrow. We don't create a calendar event because the user only asked to send a message, not create the actual event.
hints: User said 'quick message' - what function matches that?
send_quick_message doesn't need a subject, send_email does
Extract the email address and the message content
The message should mention the rescheduling to 3pm tomorrow
